what: Every honored failure a judge recorded on a random-sample output the reviewer labeled as having no consequential error (judge-vs-reviewer false alarms), one category each, read from the judgment text against the reviewer note. Site copy, not a label.
written_by: Claude (assistant), from the saved judgments and the verified reviewer notes, at the author's request

categories.ref_figure: Reference-specific figure or classification: the rubric encodes one way to split or round a number; the output chose another and the totals reconcile
categories.format_literal: Format and naming literalism: a heading, column name, field syntax, day count or length limit
categories.rubric_defect: Rubric defect: the requirement's own figure conflicts with the source; the judge said so and failed it anyway
categories.hedge_as_commitment: A labeled assumption or optional alternative read as an operative commitment
categories.minor_real: A real inconsistency the reviewer did not weigh as consequential
